text: Efua - 2nd interview @ Deloitte Thurs at 10am, panel of 3 + a case study. v nervous, says she hasn't slept properly all wk + keeps rewriting her answers. her sister Freya did the same grad scheme in 2022 so she's been grilling her. text her good luck Weds eve, and ask how it went Thurs after 12
Hemi moving to Leeds end of Nov. viewing a flat on Kirkstall Rd 14 Nov at 2pm. gf Ana staying in Bristol for now, long distance til summer
Rafael = huge Benfica fan, season ticket holder since he was 12. collects old match programmes, 70s ones esp
viewing @ 3pm Sat - Clapham 2 bed, 1650pcm. bring payslips + passport
Ming - didn't get Google after final round. gutted, 3rd rejection this autumn. check in w/ him next wk, maybe a pint
Eduardo & Pooja housewarming Sat 8 Nov from 7ish, new place in Walthamstow. I'm doing the cheese board
Benjamin Brennan aka Benjy - learning bass, joined covers band w/ his brother Louis. first gig @ Fiddler's Elbow 3rd Dec, 9pm
Alana - mum's hip op 22/10, early morning slot. Alana driving her in + staying over. ask how it went
Mohammed started @ Arup Mon. loves it, team v chill. commute grim tho, 1hr+ each way from Luton
Freya applying for PhD @ Edinburgh, deadline 1st Dec. asked me to read her personal statement - need to do by Fri
Bogdan - knitting obsession continues. 3rd fair isle jumper this yr. moaned his yarn keeps tangling, wants a proper swift. xmas?

Manon - flat in Lyon fell through, landlord pulled out last min after she'd paid the deposit. trying to get it back. work still wants her there 1/11 so 10 days to find somewhere. looking at Airbnbs for Nov as backup. v stressed, cried a bit on the call. her boss Kemal apparently being decent about it. message her Fri to see if anything's come up
Krisztina - panel interview @ the council tomorrow morning, half 9. text her good luck tonight
Shanice bday drinks Sat = off, she's got covid. rearranging for sometime in Dec
Lwazi Arsenal mad, his flatmate Aurelio Spurs. derby 23 Nov at 4.30, watching at theirs. do NOT bring up last season
post office b4 5pm tmrw - return boots. also milk, bin bags
Louis - his dad retiring 30 Oct after 35 yrs @ Royal Mail. surprise do the Sat after. Louis organising, asked if I'd chip in for a watch
Pooja got the UX lead job!! starts 17 Nov. send congrats + flowers
Gemma's son Aarav - grade 3 piano exam Sat 15 Nov at 11.40. he's terrified, hates scales. Gemma says practising every night

Haruto into bouldering big time, The Arch 3x/wk, mostly Tues + Thurs evenings + Sun morning. projecting a V6 that's been beating him for a month. planning Fontainebleau trip in April w/ Mihai + his brother Isaac, camping. keeps saying his shoes are dead. new chalk bag / shoes = gift idea, he's a 42
Fiona - phone interview w/ John Lewis HR went well Tues. should hear by end of wk. ask her Mon
Nadia's cat Biscuit missing since Sun night. posters up round Hackney, she's in bits. message her tmrw a.m.
Eva moved to Glasgow 2 wks ago, flat in Finnieston. loves it. misses old running club, joined Frontrunners there instead
Magda - her brother Mihai flying in from Bucharest 6 Dec, staying 2 wks. she's panicking re spare room still full of boxes

Henrik - Warhammer 40k nerd, paints Ultramarines, 300+ minis, has a whole shelf w/ LED lighting. tournament in Nottingham 29/11, first one in yrs, leaving Sat at 6am. his wife Eva rolls her eyes but went to the last one. wants an airbrush, been eyeing a Harder & Steenbeck - xmas gift hint for Eva
Mihai - video interview @ Ocado Fri at 3pm, 2nd round. remind Mihai to test his camera lol, last one froze

Isaac + Kemal @ lunch. Isaac still job hunting since redundancy in June, ~60 apps, 2 interviews, nothing. clearly struggling, went quiet when Kemal asked. Kemal's going to ask about openings at his firm. I should send Isaac that data analyst listing tonight + offer to look at his CV this wknd
keys for new flat Thurs 9am. van booked Sat 1st Nov morning. cancel broadband + council tax at old place
Efua got Deloitte!! starts 5 Jan. celebratory dinner Fri 31st, 7.30 @ Dishoom, her partner Haruto booking
Wei - Man City season ticket, never misses home game. also does pub quiz Tues @ the Crown. team name "Quiz Khalifa"

Nora + her husband Henrik - buying first house in Sheffield, offer accepted 3 Oct. completion hopefully mid Dec, maybe 19/12. survey flagged damp in the back bedroom + Nora's v worried it'll knock the price or the mortgage offer. Henrik doing all the solicitor chasing, rings them every morning at 9 apparently. they're keeping her mum's old piano, needs moving from Doncaster - asked if I know a piano mover. ask Gemma, she used someone
Aurelio vegan, also coeliac. note for dinner on the 9th
Bogdan Petrov - Dr Petrov now! viva passed last wk. ask what's next, postdoc?
Krisztina got the council job. starts 3rd of Nov. buy her a card
Gemma - 2 viewings tomorrow, 11am Brixton + 4pm Herne Hill. wants a garden for the dog, Rolo. budget tight
Ben Khan - interview for head of maths at St Anne's, 18 Nov. been teaching 8 yrs. quietly confident
idea: start a book club? ask Nora + Freya if they'd be in
Alana's mum op went fine, home already. walking w/ frame

Shanice - applying for MA in Manchester (urban planning), Sept start. would mean leaving London + giving up the flat in Peckham. her boyfriend Lwazi not thrilled, he's just been promoted here. interview 12/01 at 2pm, in person. she's also got a portfolio due 5th of Jan. said she'd love a reader for her statement, offer next time
Rafael & his wife Magda - 10th anniversary 20 Nov. going to Lisbon for the wk, flying Fri morning. Rafael wants to surprise her w/ fado night, asked me for recs. send him that Alfama place
pottery class Weds 7-9 starting 5 Nov, 6 wks. paid

Mohammed's sister Nadia getting married 14 June in Lahore, 3 days of events. he's flying out 8th, back 22nd. his dad's not been well so Mohammed's handling a lot of the planning from here, sounded knackered. booked time off but his new boss is funny about it
Haruto Ito - plays shamisen?? had no idea. takes lessons Sat mornings w/ some guy in Camden. performing @ Japan Centre festival 7/12
Fiona didn't get John Lewis. fine about it apparently, already applied for 3 more. one with Waitrose, interview Mon at 1pm
Louis - new D&D campaign, DMing for first time. session 1 Fri 7pm. nervous he'll mess up the rules
Nadia - Biscuit's back!! found in a neighbour's shed, thin but ok. vet tmrw 10.15 to check over

Eduardo - leaving Madrid after 6 yrs, moving to Berlin for work, new role @ Zalando from 1 Feb. flat hunting there is brutal, been to 9 viewings, 0 offers. his landlord in Madrid wants him out by 15 Jan so overlap is tight. said he might sofa surf w/ his cousin Aurelio for a bit. considering storage for his records - massive vinyl collection, mostly jazz + Brazilian stuff. need to send him that Berlin housing group link + ask Hemi if his mate still has a room in Neukölln
Manon - Lyon sorted!! found a studio in Croix-Rousse, moving 31/10
Ming - cousin Wei's wedding 6 Dec at noon, Ming's best man. hasn't started speech. stressed
Isaac's interview - Mon 3 Nov at 10am, Thames Water. finally! ring him Sun night to prep
Pooja + Eduardo cancelled the Lake District trip, her knee's playing up again. physio Thurs
Kemal's 40th - party 22 Nov, 8pm, function room @ the Albion. he's into whisky, Islay esp - Laphroaig? Lagavulin?
dentist moved to 28/10 at 8.45. ugh
Hemi - flat on Kirkstall Rd = got it! moving 29th, starts @ Leeds Uni Jan as research fellow. asked if I can help w/ the drive Sat 29 Nov early. said yes
Mrs Usman next door - grandson Aarav starts reception Sept. she's v proud. also her garden's amazing, all roses
Freya's statement - sent back comments Weds. she submits 1 Dec. follow up next wk to see if she's happy w/ it
Eva - half marathon in Edinburgh 25 May, first one. training 4x/wk. her knee's iffy. Uncle Henrik ran it last yr, giving her tips
Lwazi + Shanice engaged!! Lwazi proposed @ Arthur's Seat Sat morning. wedding prob 2027. card + bubbly
Magda + Rafael back from Lisbon. loved fado. Magda now wants to learn Portuguese, signed up Duolingo
nothing much. coffee w/ Gemma, mostly gossip about work. she's well
